description: Proposal under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 regarding the extensions and alterations to existing building including the erection of part one/part two storey extensions to the side and rear, the addition of a second and third floor to provide 35 flats comprising 9 studio flats, 15 x 1 bed, 8 x 2 bed and 3 x 3 bed with associated parking and amenities to allow changes to the approved drawings being revisions to the layout to provide 36 flats comprising 2 studio flats, 20 x 1 bed, 10 x 2 bed, 2 x 3 bed and 2 x 4 bed including retention of the single storey extension and changes to the external layout
